Reference:  Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as 
amended and our earlier intimation dated April 28,2026 regarding 
Earning Call with Analyst(s)/Institutional investor(s) 
 
Subject:    
Audio recording of Earning Call | Q4 and FY2026 results 
 
 
Dear Sir/Ma’am, 
 
In terms of Regulations 30 and 46 read with Part A of Schedule III of the Securities and 
Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015, as amended, we hereby inform that the audio recording of the Earnings Call held 
with analyst(s)/institutional investor(s) on the Audited Financial Results (Standalone and 
Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026, 
on Friday, May 08, 2026, has been made available on the website of the Company. 
 
The recording can be accessed from the link given below:  
 
https://www.acmesolar.in/assets/pdf/Webcasts-and-Transcripts/08.05.2026_Q4_FY26_Earning_Call_Recording.mp3  
 
 
 
 
We request you to kindly take the aforesaid information on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
For ACME Solar Holdings Limited 
 
 
 
Rajesh Sodhi 
Company Secretary and Compliance Officer 
RAJESH 
SODHI
